verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs give one batch limit (up to 100 requests per call, with webhooks for completion) and an Enterprise claim that dedicated GPUs mean renders "never queue behind anyone." Neither documents concurrent-render limits or how queuing works on standard plans. That is only glancing support for planning a production pipeline. Missing for 10: documented per-plan concurrency limits, queue ordering/wait-time behavior, rate-limit and retry semantics for batch jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
